authorization: Founder: proceed with full end-to-end GLM-versus-CTC comparison.

inputs.model_hash_scheme: runner _hash_tree: sorted relative path bytes followed by each file's SHA-256 hex text

geometry: Reuse frozen detector_v1_boxes.json for both readers; do not rerun detection.
judgement: Both reader transcripts use production alignment and the same models/cctc_tall CoreML spelling judge. Non-spelling marks remain active because they have no spelling margin.

folds.rule: Select each reader's spelling threshold only on development pages, freeze it, then run sealed pages once.

no_key.definition: counts_as_error is true and deferred is false

extended.definition: counts_as_error is true, including 113 deferred records
extended.status: human-adjudicated proxy only; not teacher-key truth

selection.objective: maximize caught no-key labels, then minimize false marks, under budget
selection.extended_threshold: reuse the no-key development threshold unchanged

reported_metrics: reader transcription error against the pupil transcript
no-key catch and false marks per 100 scored words
extended proxy catch and false marks at the same frozen threshold
missing_word, extra_word, capitalization, punctuation and spelling mark counts
compute_rule: Never CPU. GLM must resolve to MPS or CUDA; CTC reading and judgement must resolve to CoreML.
